issues.quote: I was alone in the library, Inspector, directly under his bench.
issues.fact: F3 says only that the thump was on the floor right above the library, in the atelier. It does not place the uncle's bench or say where the thump landed.
issues.misreading: A solver could take 'directly under his bench' as pinning the thump to a specific spot in the atelier, which the sheet does not give.

issues.quote: My aunt's piano was playing downstairs when the thump came. I could hear it through the floor, Chopin, I think.
issues.fact: F5 says only that the aunt's piano was playing downstairs when the thump came. It gives no location for the piano relative to the library.
issues.misreading: 'Through the floor' places the piano directly beneath the library, a whereabouts detail the sheet does not supply.
